title: LiveAgentStreamSchedule
description: live.agent-stream-schedule@1 (Agent Streams S7): an owner's schedule for a public agent stream. A schedule names a time, the task template the desk will run and the mode; Live starts it when the owner's desk is online, and when the desk is not it says 'didn't start: the desk was offline' and runs nothing. A chatplays schedule never starts on its own: it waits for the owner's Go (the S6 rule). The schedule shows on the channel's Agents tab and in Today 24 hours before its time. The id is scd_<ULID>; the started stream (if any) is named by agent_stream_id.

owner.description: The person whose desk runs the scheduled task.

mode.description: How the stream is played. Watch, Narrated and Co-pilot may start on schedule; chatplays waits for the owner's Go.

visibility.description: Who may watch the stream the schedule starts. Today shows public schedules only.

state.description: Where the schedule stands: scheduled, live (with agent_stream_id), ended, missed ('didn't start: the desk was offline') or cancelled by its owner.

agent_stream_id.description: The stream the schedule started, once it did.

missed_reason.description: Why a scheduled start did not happen. 'waits_for_go' is a chatplays schedule keeping its time until the owner presses Go; 'desk_offline' is the design's 'didn't start: the desk was offline'.

waits_for_go.description: True for a chatplays schedule: the time has come but nothing runs until the owner presses Go.

reminders.description: How many followers opted in to a reminder; neighbours never see who they are.

reminded.description: For the caller's own view: whether this caller opted in to a reminder. Absent when there is no caller.

page_url.description: The channel's Agents tab, where the schedule shows 24 hours before its time.
